content.user_title: Optimize Application Performance Across the Stack
content.value_statement: Application bottlenecks often span services, databases, browsers, and infrastructure. This skill coordinates profiling, targeted optimization, load testing, and continuous monitoring across the stack.
actual_capabilities: Establish performance baselines using profiling, tracing, real-user metrics, and critical journey measurements.
Assess observability gaps and recommend instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, SLIs, and SLOs.
Plan database, backend, distributed system, frontend, mobile, CDN, and edge optimizations.
Design realistic load, stress, and regression tests with measurable budgets and rollback triggers.
Define continuous monitoring, capacity planning, and optimization review processes.
limitations: Requires environment-specific metrics, tracing, profiling data, and architecture context for reliable recommendations.
Does not replace production validation, change approval, rollback planning, or expert review.
Suggested tools and thresholds must be adapted to workload, budget, compliance, and user requirements.
Load testing production requires explicit authorization, safeguards, and controlled execution.

use_cases.title: Reduce Service Latency
use_cases.description: Build an evidence-based plan to reduce service latency while preserving reliability and rollback readiness.

use_cases.title: Improve User Experience
use_cases.description: Prioritize Core Web Vitals, bundle, loading, mobile, and CDN improvements using measured user impact.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Performance Work
use_cases.description: Create a cross-team program with baselines, budgets, ownership, capacity planning, and regression controls.

prompt_templates.title: Find Initial Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review {application} using {available_metrics}. Identify the three most important bottlenecks, define baseline metrics, and propose low-risk validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Backend Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze {service_profile}, {slow_queries}, and {traffic_pattern}. Recommend database and backend changes ranked by impact, effort, risk, and required measurements.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Cross-Stack Improvements
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased optimization plan for {application}. Cover observability, backend, frontend, infrastructure, load testing, performance budgets, rollout safeguards, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Performance Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an enterprise performance program for {architecture} under {constraints}. Define SLIs, SLOs, capacity models, experiments, regression gates, rollback triggers, ownership, and review cadence.

output_examples.input: Our checkout API slows during peak traffic. Create an investigation plan.
output: Baseline checkout latency, throughput, error rate, database time, and resource saturation during normal and peak periods.
Profile the request path, rank bottlenecks by measured contribution, then test one controlled change at a time.
Validate P95 improvement under realistic load and monitor errors, cost, and rollback signals.

output_examples.input: Improve Core Web Vitals for a mobile storefront.
output: Measure LCP, interaction latency, layout stability, bundle size, and critical journey timing with real-user data.
Prioritize render-blocking resources, oversized bundles, images, and third-party scripts by user impact.
Validate changes on representative mobile devices and slow networks before staged release.

output_examples.input: Create continuous performance controls for our services.
output: Define service-level indicators, performance budgets, representative test workloads, and accountable owners.
Add regression gates for critical paths and staged rollback triggers for material degradation.
Review capacity, cost, user impact, and optimization opportunities on a regular schedule.

best_practices: Start with baselines and explicit success metrics before recommending implementation changes.
Change one bottleneck at a time and compare results against the same representative workload.
Use staged rollouts, monitoring, and rollback criteria for every production-facing optimization.
anti_patterns: Optimizing from assumptions without profiling, tracing, or real-user evidence.
Running uncontrolled load tests against production systems or shared dependencies.
Declaring success from average latency while ignoring tail latency, errors, resource use, and cost.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide architecture, critical journeys, current metrics, traffic patterns, constraints, available tools, and target outcomes.

faq.question: Does the skill run monitoring or load-testing tools?
faq.answer: The skill provides an orchestration workflow. Tool access, permissions, integrations, and execution depend on the active agent environment.

faq.question: Can it address both frontend and backend performance?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow covers browsers, mobile clients, APIs, databases, distributed systems, infrastructure, CDN, and edge delivery.

faq.question: Is production load testing recommended?
faq.answer: Only with explicit approval, safeguards, realistic scenarios, monitoring, isolation controls, and a tested stop procedure.

faq.question: What outputs can the workflow produce?
faq.answer: It can produce assessments, prioritized plans, test strategies, performance budgets, monitoring recommendations, capacity models, and regression controls.

faq.question: Are the example performance targets universal?
faq.answer: No. Adapt every threshold to measured user needs, service objectives, architecture, traffic, cost, and operational constraints.
